answers.question: Q13. You said reads may be retried on timeout without limit. Nothing then ends a list call that keeps getting no answer, and you also said that when the re-read fails the agent says the outcome is unknown and hands off. The shortest path: the customer says yes; the cancel call gets no answer; the agent lists the orders; no answer; it lists again; no answer; and so on. What ends it?
answers.recommended: The agent tries a list call at most three times. After the third no answer the read has failed: after an unanswered cancel or refund it does what you said for a failed re-read; at the start of the conversation it tells the customer it cannot look up their orders right now and changes nothing.
answers.reply: > Reads may be retried on timeout without limit; only commit calls are bounded.

answers.question: Q14. Two outcomes you added have no handling yet. (a) The cancel call answers OrderNotFound, though the agent took the order from the customer's own list. (b) The refund call answers OrderNotCancelled, though the order system had shown the order cancelled. What does the agent do in each?
answers.recommended: (a) It tells the customer it could not cancel the order, issues no refund, and creates a follow-up task for staff with the reason "cancellation unknown". (b) It tells the customer the refund was not issued, and creates a follow-up task for staff with the reason "refund not issued".

answers.question: Q15. When the customer names an order number that matches none of their orders, the agent says so and changes nothing, and the customer may then name another. Nothing ends that. The shortest path: the customer names a number that matches none; the agent says so; the customer names another; the agent says so; and so on. What ends it?
answers.recommended: After the third order number that matches none of their orders, the agent tells the customer it cannot find the order and asks them to contact Harbor Goods support.

answers.question: Q16. A customer may want to cancel more than one order in one conversation. Nothing says how many. What ends it?
answers.recommended: The agent handles one order at a time, each with its own proposal and its own yes, finishing one before starting the next. Each order can be cancelled only once, so the customer's open orders bound it.
